output_difference.meaning: Difference from BF16 output; this is not accuracy against a reference try-on image.

limits: One pair and one generation per precision; no quality benchmark or timing distribution.
Weight-only INT4 for both denoisers' Linear layers; other layers and activations keep their original dtype.
Host peak RSS includes model loading and quantization when performed in-process.
Desktop CPU checkpoint layout is not an Android/iOS deployment package or phone memory measurement.
The two CPU generation jobs overlap on a shared host; elapsed times are diagnostic, not an isolated speed comparison.
